newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 19.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 19.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Perpetual Trustee Co Ltd said late on Tuesday it hoped to achieve growth in net profit for the year ended June 30, 1997 compared with the previous year. Perpetual reported a net profit of A$11.76 million in the six months to December 31, up from A$6.29 million a year earlier.
* Energy Resources of Australia Ltd A$5.65 (+0.05)

Australian uranium miner Energy Resources of Australia Ltd (ERA) said on Tuesday it had signed a loan agreement for 1,360 tonnes of uranium concentrate from one its substantial shareholders. The loan enabled ERA to increase forecast sales for the 12 month period to June 1997 to more than 5,000 tonnes of uranium oxide.

QNI Ltd said late on Tuesday that if the improving trend in metal prices seen since the start of 1997 continued, the company would see an improvement in profit in the second half of the 1996/97 year (July-June). Earlier it report a fall in first half profit to A$13.32 million from A$52.45 million.
The Helsinki Stock Exchange said on Tuesday it had chosen a new trading and information system to be supplied by the London office of Australian Computershare Systems Pty Ltd.

Woolworths Ltd's wholesale expansion plans through its Australian Independent Wholesalers (AIW) unit should not have a big impact on the market share of competitor, Davids Ltd, analysts said late on Tuesday.
Leading companies release their half year profit results during the day.
